frame.origin: Seiya's feet where the column of light stands at his tag 37.132 s (the fight's ground)

frame.law: a drawn film has no one lens: every mu below was read off the frames named in its evidence, and its sigma is how far the frames allow it to move. Two spaces disagree by design: the over-the-shoulder shots (28 to 37 s, 71 to 73 s) put the fight 14 to 22 m from Athena; the establishing shot (42.6 to 44.5 s) puts her on a rock pinnacle above the clouds, a hundred metres up. The page replicates the shots, so it takes the cinematographic space; the establishing one is kept beside it.

sources.what: Athena bound as the figurehead of the ship on the statue of Odin
sources.words: She is immobilized by the master of Asgard, and put as the figurehead of the ship on the statue of Odin.
Seiya tries to fight him but fails, and is followed by Ikki and Hyouga. Suddenly the Gold Cloth of Sagitarius appears, and enrobes Seiya.
in a strange dimension within the giant statue of Odin

a scene with E00 posed: Saori's only motion is ME00.MPL (8 frames of her lips); none of the 174 story motion files (SCRIPT\MOTION\STORY_xxxx_NN.FJF) names her, and she is no fighter (no 50.MPL, no SKILL folder, no select name), so no pad press puts her in an arena; her place above it and the camera over her shoulder are writes into EE RAM, an edit of the game

road.pine: 127.0.0.1:28011 on pelino (TCP, its ini), reached by an ssh -L bound in time; MsgRead64 batches of 8 B a read: a 60-node figure's world matrices are 480 reads (3,840 B), both figures and the camera object about 1,020 reads a sample; PINE reads between the emulator's frames, so a per-frame record wants the game paused or the hook's packet 17 (493 B, 5.4 to 5.8 us a frame on the Mac, Oct 4)
road.units: 1 game unit = 0.10 m, y down, the floor y = 0, row vectors with the translation in row 3; this record's frame is metres, y up, the origin at Seiya's feet
